subject: table: remove method `Txn()` in `MutateContext` (#55400)
summary: Reviewed only this commit vs first parent, scoped to `pkg/executor/*` and `pkg/table/*`. Change removes `MutateContext.Txn()` and threads `kv.Transaction` explicitly through `table.Table` mutators (`AddRecord`/`UpdateRecord`/`RemoveRecord`). Executor call sites consistently fetch `txn` via `sessionctx.Context.Txn(true)` before invoking table writes (delete/update/insert paths), and table implementations/wrappers (common/partitioned/cached) now use the passed `txn` without altering DML ordering, staging-buffer patterns, or constraint/index maintenance logic. No Blocker/High issues found in transaction/session semantics, correctness, or data consistency within the requested scope.
